**About Parallel Export Products
**
Recently, there have been reports of Accuphase products being resold outside Japan. Accuphase
products are manufactured and sold to meet the safety regulations of the countries where they are
dealt. If products in compliance with the safety regulations of Japan are used in foreign lands,
ignition or other defects are at risk, and serious accidents have actually occurred. Accuphase
strongly advises against obtaining products with Japan's safety regulations or modified goods that
are parallel-exported. Instead, we urge you to rely on our trusted authorized dealers for all your
Accuphase product purchases.

### NEW PRODUCTS

[[DG-78]][25]

[Jincheng Yu]Jincheng Yu

NVIDIA's SANA-Video 2.0, a video Diffusion Transformer, efficiently generates high-quality video by
integrating a hybrid linear attention mechanism with periodic softmax anchors and attention
residuals. The 5B model generated an 81-frame video in 13.2 seconds on a single H100 GPU, achieving
a VBench Total score of 84.30 while offering a 3.2x faster DiT forward pass for 720p/60s compared to
full-softmax baselines.

AREX, a recursively self-improving agent framework from BAAI, introduces a novel bi-level

[Hadi Alzayer]Hadi Alzayer
[Wenlong Huang]Wenlong Huang
[Haonan Chen]Haonan Chen

Researchers from Stanford University and collaborators developed Masked Visual Actions (MVA), a
pixel-space control interface that enables a single pre-trained video model to function as a unified
world model for both forward and inverse dynamics in robot manipulation. This approach achieved
superior visual fidelity and cross-embodiment generalization in controllable video generation,
improved planning success rates by up to 26% on Robocasa tasks, and demonstrated zero-shot inverse
modeling with 90% success on a complex pick-and-place task.

Introducing the Hilbert Operator for Progressive Encoding (HOPE), a mathematical framework that
models deep network neurons as rank-1 Hilbert-Schmidt operators in a continuous Hilbert space,
enabling unbiased and data-free (for BN networks) deconstruction of learned representations. This
framework facilitated superior structured model compression and a novel transfer learning method,
DEFT, which balanced stability and plasticity more effectively than baselines by analytically
partitioning core and slack neurons.

[Project Pilot: Can AI control a drone?][65]
24 Jul 2026
AnthropicAndon Labs

Anthropic's Frontier Red Team, working with Andon Labs, tested whether AI models can autonomously
fly a quad-rotor drone through an indoor office to locate and follow a specific person — a
locate-and-follow task representative of aerial surveillance. Andon Labs decomposed the mission into
five sub-tasks (Reconstruct, Localize, Navigate, Detect, Follow), reproduced each in simulation as
the Drone-Bench benchmark, and scored 15 models from three developers against a baseline set by
human-AI teams using coding agents. Newer models get successively further on every sub-task, with
Claude Fable 5 passing the baseline on all tasks except Reconstruct, whose failure compounds into
localization and navigation errors and blocks end-to-end autonomy on the real drone.

the upstream grading path while normalizing lifecycles, hides grading material from the agent's

AnthropicAndon Labs

Anthropic's Frontier Red Team, working with Andon Labs, tested whether AI models can autonomously
fly a quad-rotor drone through an indoor office to locate and follow a specific person — a
locate-and-follow task representative of aerial surveillance. Andon Labs decomposed the mission into
five sub-tasks (Reconstruct, Localize, Navigate, Detect, Follow), reproduced each in simulation as
the Drone-Bench benchmark, and scored 15 models from three developers against a baseline set by
human-AI teams using coding agents. Newer models get successively further on every sub-task, with
Claude Fable 5 passing the baseline on all tasks except Reconstruct, whose failure compounds into
localization and navigation errors and blocks end-to-end autonomy on the real drone.

# Instrumentation ARINST

ARINST is available measuring instruments for radio Amateurs, repairmen and installers of radio
equipment. Devices ARINST much cheaper counterparts, but the user receives everything needed to
function.

An important distinctive feature of the ARINST devices is the presence of a 3.2” color touch screen
and a control button block that allows you to measure and analyze the results without connecting to
external devices. All measured data are displayed on the instrument screen in real time.
The second important feature of the devices is their autonomy and versatility in use. All devices
are equipped with a built-in Li-Ion battery.

The devices are made in a durable aluminum case and are lightweight, small in size and have low
power consumption. Devices are recommended for use when carrying out repair, commissioning and
measuring works, both in field, and in laboratory conditions.
* **Portable spectrum analyzers with built-in tracking generator and without it**

───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
[**ARINST SSA R2**][8] is an easy portable panoramic spectrum analyzer (RF multimeter) designed to 
display signal spectrums in the frequency range from 35 to 6200 MHz. The analyzer finds the        
amplitude and frequency of spectral components of the analyzed process.                            
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
[**ARINST SSA-TG R2**][9] is an easy portable panoramic spectrum analyzer (RF multimeter) designed 
to display signal spectrums in the frequency range from 35 to 6200 MHz. Another important feature  
is the presence of additional capabilities of the tracking generator, which makes it possible to   
measure the frequency response of passive or active devices, for example filters or amplifiers. The
software allows measuring SWR and return loss module. This requires an external directional coupler
and a set of calibration measures.                                                                 
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
[**ARINST SSA R2 Signal Hunter**][10] is an easy portable spectrum analyzer designed to display    
signal spectrums in the frequency range from 35 to 6200 MHz. The device allows to determine the    
amplitude and frequency of the spectral components that compose the signal. The main purpose of the
device is the detection of packet (pulsed) radio signals and radio transmitting devices of all     
modern communication systems. High scanning speed compared to other versions of ARINST analyzers is
achieved through the use of two frequency synthesizers. For advanced analysis, functions for       
displaying the time-frequency spectrum "waterfall chart" and "digital phosphorus" have been added. 
They are designed to observe the evolution of signals in both the frequency and time domains.      
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
[**ARINST SSA-TG LC R2**][11] is a panoramic spectrum analyzer with built-in signal generator,     
which is designed to display the spectrum of signals in the main frequency range 36 to 5990 MHz.   
**ARINST SSA-TG LC R2** is a cost-reduced version of [**ARINST SSA-TG R2**][12]. There is no built 
in battery and data transfer via bluetooth in the LC version. The device transmits data and        
receives power only by USB cable. The device allows to determine the amplitude and frequency of    
spectral components included in the signal. Another important feature is the presence of an        
additional function signal generator, which allows to measure the frequency response of active     
devices such as a repeater, to measure the SWR of antennas, etc.                                   
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

* **Portable vector network analyzers**

───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
**Portable 2-port vector network analyzer ** [**ARINST VNA-PR1 1-6200 MHz**][13]. The device       
measures parameters S11 and S21, voltage standing wave ratio (VSWR), impedance, admittance, phase, 
group delay (GD), distance to cable fault. The analyzer is designed for setting and matching the   
characteristics of passive and active radio devices (antennas, cables, filters, attenuators,       
amplifiers), checking the integrity of high-frequency cables, measuring their parameters, and other
amateur radio measurements.                                                                        
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
*

amplifiers), checking the integrity of high-frequency cables, measuring their parameters, and other
amateur radio measurements.                                                                        
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
**Portable vector network analyzer (reflectometer)** [**ARINST VR 1-6200 MHz**][14] is designed to 
measure the matching characteristics of passive and active radio devices (antennas, cables,        
filters, attenuators, amplifiers, etc.) The device allows you to measure the parameters of the     
complex reflection coefficient, standing wave ratio (SWR), impedance, admittance, magnitude, phase,
loss and distance to fault in the cable.                                                           
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
**Portable vector network analyzer (reflectometer)** [**ARINST VR 23-6200 MHz**][15] is designed to
measure the matching characteristics of passive and active radio devices (antennas, cables,        
filters, attenuators, amplifiers, etc.) The device allows you to measure the parameters of the     
complex reflection coefficient, standing wave ratio (SWR), impedance, admittance, magnitude, phase,
loss and distance to fault in the cable.                                                           
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

* **Power amplifier**

───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
[**ARINST KPAM-3000**][16] is designed to amplify the input high-frequency signal in the frequency 
range of 200-3000 MHz. The source of the high-frequency signal is a sweep generator of the spectrum
analyzer, from which the signal is fed to the test device through a power amplifier.               
The amplifier is used in high-frequency signal amplification paths. The input power level must not 
exceed the value specified in the technical specifications of the device. The amplifier is powered 
by a built-in Li-Ion battery.                                                                      
The power amplifier is designed to work in conjunction with ARINST spectrum analyzers that have an 
integrated tracking generator, for example [**ARINST SSA-TG R2**][17], but it is also possible to  
work with devices from other manufacturers equipped with a signal generator and providing an output
signal with a power in the range from -25 to -15 dBm.                                              
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

All ARINST devices are constantly being improved, work algorithms are being changed and optimized,
new useful functions are being added. Innovations are made available to users through automatic
software updates via Google Play. All updates are also available for download from our official
website.

In addition to devices, we offer additional equipment that expands the scope of ARINST devices:

* **Measuring antennas**

───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
[**KM6-600/6000**][18] - directional passive log-periodic measuring antenna with a gain of up to 6 
dB.                                                                                                
It’s intended for execution of radio frequency measurements (measurement of field intensity and    
peak (amplitude) direction finding of the sources of electromagnetic radiation). It operates in a  
frequency range of 600 MHz to 6000 MHz.                                                            
The antenna has regulated gain in operational range of frequencies. It is recommended to analyze   
the electromagnetic environment in the set with a spectrum analyzer.                               
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
[**KPM15-790/2700**][19] - directional panel measuring antenna with the gain up to 15 dB.          
Antenna is designed for execution RF measurements (field strength measurements and measurements of 
amplitude direction finding of sources of electromagnetic radiation) in the frequency range 790-960
MHz and 1700-2700 MHz.                                                                             
The antenna has regulated gain in operational range of frequencies. It is recommended to analyze   
the electromagnetic environment in the set with a spectrum analyzer.                               
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

* * **Calibration kits**
* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  [**Calibration kit SMA-MF06**][20]. Frequency range 0-6000 MHz, 50 Ohm.                          
  The calibration set provides high accuracy of measurements in the frequency range from 0 to 6000 
  MHz. Designed for use in both practical and laboratory environments. Requires a careful handling.
  Excessive loads can disable the set.                                                             
  This calibration set is recommended to buy together with the [**measuring bridge of the standing 
  wave ratio (SWR bridge)**][21] and spectrum analyzer [**ARINST SSA-TG R2**][22].                 
  ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  [**Calibration kit N-MF06**][23]. Frequency range 0-6000 MHz, 50 Ohm.                            
  The calibration set provides high accuracy of measurements in the frequency range from 0 to 6000 
  MHz. Designed for use in both practical and laboratory environments. Requires a careful handling.
  Excessive loads can disable the set.                                                             
  ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
* * **EOR VNA - Software option to extend the operating frequency range of ARINST VNA**
* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  [**EOR VNA******][24]**** - is a software option that allows you to expand the frequency range of
  portable vector network analyzers:                                                               
                                                                                                   
  * ARINST VR 23-1600                                                                              
  * ARINST VR 23-2600                                                                              
  * ARINST VR 23-3000                                                                              
  * ARINST SSA R2 3 GHz                                                                            
  * ARINST SSA-TG R2 3 GHz                                                                         
                                                                                                   
  ****                                                                                             
  ────────────────────────────────────

#### **Guangzhou Gisen Audio Equipment Factory**

GISEN AUDIO is a comprehensive company and power amplifier supplier who develops, produces, sells
and services independently. Not only we have a strict operating system, but also a team built with
young, pioneering, innovating, and hard-working staff. In the aspects of technology research and
development, product service, we have higher demands on ourselves. After constant efforts of staff,
products with GISEN characteristics continuously come out.

As the high requirements of power amplifier on various occasion, GISEN power amplifier has adopted
an effective heat dissipation system and thoroughly considered circuit protection: with a clipping
limiter (which strengthens the protection of the loudspeaker), direct current protection, hypo-low
frequency loudspeaker protection, overheat protection, and a temperature control system which can
adjust the output power according to the changes of temperature. No matter there is short circuit,
longtime full load working, or over increase input signal, the power amplifier would still be in
full functional mode.

GISEN professional amplifier reverts to the sound source and timbre loyally and it has little
interference to the audio signal as GISEN pursues pure style and smooth characteristics.

With more than a decade’s experience and technology, we make our own analog amplifier, digital
amplifier and DSP amplifier. And they have been widely used in live show, theater system, KTV,
entertainment club, conference, show, etc. GISEN will keep improving the quality and service, as we
hope there will be more interaction, mutual trust and benefit between us. Hand in hand, we can build

Beyond the concept of a compact streamer

## DS-5.2

Compact, fully balanced and deeply versatile, designed to unite the world of traditional
high-fidelity with the needs of contemporary listening.
The DS-5.2 was created to eliminate everything that stands between the recording and the listener.

[ Discover more ][21]
Rediscover your vinyl records

## PH-5.2

Proudly made in Italy, the innovative touchscreen interface allows you to easily adjust impedance
and gain in real time and select the ideal equalisation curves for each vinyl record. Anodized
aluminum chassis improved background noise reduction and micro-details.

[ Discover more ][22]
Rediscover listening with headphones

## HP-5.2

Anodized aluminum chassis for improved background noise reduction and micro-details. Enhanced power
supply for greater dynamic stability, cleaner high frequencies, and a relaxed yet authoritative
sound. Intuitive display layout, 4 headphone outputs, advanced features such as adjustable
Crossfeed, Harman, and Damping Factor.

[ Discover more ][23]
Unrivalled audio excellence

## Diana II

Diana II is designed to deliver maximum performance in any environment, thanks to its 1‘ silk dome
tweeter for crystal-clear highs, two 6.5’ treated paper mid-woofers in a D’Appolito configuration
for warm, balanced sound, and a rear bass reflex system for deep, powerful bass, even when the
loudspeakers are placed close to a wall.

[ Discover more ][24]
Elegance meets performance

## Diana I

Equipped with a rear bass-reflex system, 6.5″ fiberglass mid-woofers, side resonators, and a 1″ silk
dome tweeter featuring a mechanical dome phaser, it delivers an unparalleled listening experience.
With 88dB sensitivity, it ensures exceptional performance even when paired with low-power
amplifiers.

[ Discover more ][25]
The new generation headphone amplifier

## HP-10

The new high-end headphone amplifier for discerning audiophiles, featuring a Dual-Mono Class-A
balanced design, 4 headphone outputs, the extensive features and powerful output to support any type
of headphones. Available in three different models, with the additional digital inputs such as the
Bluetooth 5.1 HD aptX and a premium DAC with USB-C input.

[ Discover more ][26]
OUR NEW CD PLAYER

## CD-10

The CD-10 is a fantastic addition to our electronics of the 10 Series, a modern CD player designed
for compact High-End systems to bring the magic of music in your living room.
Featuring a mechanism made in Austria by Stream Unlimited and the ultra-precise D/A converter AK4493
made in Japan – all controlled via a touchscreen display with a super intuitive menu.

[ Discover more ][27]
Discover the new integrated streaming amplifier

## IS-10

The new compact all-in-one device in our 10 series is a complete high-end stereo system with a
powerful 90 W @ 8Ω (stereo) integrated amplifier, a D/A converter with high-resolution streaming and
an audiophile headphone preamplifier with 6.3 mm plug for driving headphones of all kinds.

[ Discover more ][28]
The ultimate italian turntable

## Mediterraneo X

Mediterraneo X is our flagship turntable. Handcrafted in Italy with the finest materials, this
masterpiece is the ultimate expression of analogue audio. Exquisite design meets precision
engineering applied to the art of reproducing vinyl.
Discover the Italian turntable.

The PH-5.2 is a complete design evolution, not just a simple update of the PH-5.
The changes introduced – chassis, power supply and overall architecture – cannot be implemented
through a simple firmware update. The new black anodised aluminium chassis reduces interaction with
magnetic fields, improving background silence and micro-detail.
The upgraded power supply ensures greater dynamic stability, cleaner high frequencies and a relaxed
yet authoritative sound.
Finally, the display with a clearer layout, faster adjustments and more options offers a high-level
user experience.

offer, aimed at satisfying the demands of those who share a passion for Italian sound.

loudspeakers are placed close to a wall.

## Diana I

Equipped with a rear bass-reflex system, 6.5″ fiberglass mid-woofers, side resonators, and a 1″ silk
dome tweeter featuring a mechanical dome phaser, it delivers an unparalleled listening experience.
With 88dB sensitivity, it ensures exceptional performance even when paired with low-power
amplifiers.

[ Discover more ][25]
The new generation headphone amplifier

## HP-10

The new high-end headphone amplifier for discerning audiophiles, featuring a Dual-Mono Class-A
balanced design, 4 headphone outputs, the extensive features and powerful output to support any type
of headphones. Available in three different models, with the additional digital inputs such as the
Bluetooth 5.1 HD aptX and a premium DAC with USB-C input.

[ Discover more ][26]
OUR NEW CD PLAYER

## CD-10

The CD-10 is a fantastic addition to our electronics of the 10 Series, a modern CD player designed
for compact High-End systems to bring the magic of music in your living room.
Featuring a mechanism made in Austria by Stream Unlimited and the ultra-precise D/A converter AK4493
made in Japan – all controlled via a touchscreen display with a super intuitive menu.

[ Discover more ][27]
Discover the new integrated streaming amplifier

## IS-10

The new compact all-in-one device in our 10 series is a complete high-end stereo system with a
powerful 90 W @ 8Ω (stereo) integrated amplifier, a D/A converter with high-resolution streaming and
an audiophile headphone preamplifier with 6.3 mm plug for driving headphones of all kinds.

[ Discover more ][28]
The ultimate italian turntable

## Mediterraneo X

Mediterraneo X is our flagship turntable. Handcrafted in Italy with the finest materials, this
masterpiece is the ultimate expression of analogue audio. Exquisite design meets precision
engineering applied to the art of reproducing vinyl.
Discover the Italian turntable.

## PH-5.2 Rediscover your vinyl records

The PH-5.2 is a complete design evolution, not just a simple update of the PH-5.
The changes introduced – chassis, power supply and overall architecture – cannot be implemented
through a simple firmware update. The new black anodised aluminium chassis reduces interaction with
magnetic fields, improving background silence and micro-detail.
The upgraded power supply ensures greater dynamic stability, cleaner high frequencies and a relaxed
yet authoritative sound.
Finally, the display with a clearer layout, faster adjustments and more options offers a high-level
user experience.

[ ][30]

## Range

Upstream of every audio reproduction equipment there is an idea of sound that could not exist
without a necessary reflection on the whole system. In other words, it would make no sense to focus
on one link without thinking about the whole chain. And this is why Gold Note proposes an integrated
offer, aimed at satisfying the demands of those who share a passion for Italian sound.

### Broad Scope

Impact of your work will have on researchers outside your field and the potential for greater

### Indexed

### Peer-Reviewed

In the area of research and innovation, each day we passionately push the limits of science and

IJER 100% emphasis on high quality research content, thorough peer-review which exists on all our

spectrum of engineering areas.

Manuscripts submitted to The International Journal of Engineering Research & Technology should:
* contribute to existing research work;
* be original, and not have been published anywhere;
* present data clearly and concisely;
* mention engineering data & applications;

All accepted papers in IJERT will be published under a Creative Commons Licence and will be freely
available on the IJERT Digital Library.

IJERT has the team of **more than **[2000 prominent reviewers][44]** and renowned [editorial board
members][45]** from well-known academic institutions around the globe. The primary goal of the
reviewers & editors is to maintain high quality of publications. The articles that are sent for
reviews are handled by state of art online manuscript review system, with a view towards making fast
& fair review process. The Editors reserve the right to reject papers without sending them out for
review.

The IJERT is not limited to a specific areas of science and engineering but is instead covers wide
range of branches of engineering and sciences. The major subject areas covered by the journal are
following:
* Computer Science & Engineering
* Architecture and Planning
* Applied Sciences
* Applied Engineering
* Electronics & Communication Engineering
* Chemical Engineering
* Civil Engineering
* Textile Engineering
* Environmental Engineering
* Electrical Engineering
* Industrial Engineering
* Mechanical Engineering [**and more**][46]

The IJERT’s GOLD OPEN ACCESS model is supported through very nominal Article Processing Charges.
There is **no any fee associated with submission to this journal.** We also offer discounts to
students and **100% fee waivers for researchers** in developing countries, determined using the
criteria* set by [WorldBank.][47]

Almost all university and colleges research in both science and engineering is performed as a
component of the advanced education of students. For most engineering & science students, the goal
of a career in industry motivates their pursuit of advanced study, and this will increasingly be the
case in the future and IJERT helps them to achieve their goal.

included in many leading abstracting and indexing open access databases like Google Scholar &
ResearchGate. For a complete list, [view here.][42]

articles. The open access supports the rights of users to read, download, copy, distribute, print,
search, or link to the full texts of these articles provided they are properly acknowledged and

Manuscripts submitted to The International Journal of Engineering Research & Technology should:
* contribute to existing research work;
* be original, and not have been published anywhere;
* present data clearly and concisely;
* mention engineering data & applications;

All accepted papers in IJERT will be published under a Creative Commons Licence and will be freely
available on the IJERT Digital Library.

IJERT has the team of **more than **[2000 prominent reviewers][44]** and renowned [editorial board
members][45]** from well-known academic institutions around the globe. The primary goal of the
reviewers & editors is to maintain high quality of publications. The articles that are sent for
reviews are handled by state of art online manuscript review system, with a view towards making fast
& fair review process. The Editors reserve the right to reject papers without sending them out for
review.

The IJERT is not limited to a specific areas of science and engineering but is instead covers wide
range of branches of engineering and sciences. The major subject areas covered by the journal are
following:
* Computer Science & Engineering
* Architecture and Planning
* Applied Sciences
* Applied Engineering
* Electronics & Communication Engineering
* Chemical Engineering
* Civil Engineering
* Textile Engineering
* Environmental Engineering
* Electrical Engineering
* Industrial Engineering
* Mechanical Engineering [**and more**][46]

The IJERT’s GOLD OPEN ACCESS model is supported through very nominal Article Processing Charges.
There is **no any fee associated with submission to this journal.** We also offer discounts to
students and **100% fee waivers for researchers** in developing countries, determined using the
criteria* set by [WorldBank.][47]

Almost all university and colleges research in both science and engineering is performed as a
component of the advanced education of students. For most engineering & science students, the goal
of a career in industry motivates their pursuit of advanced study, and this will increasingly be the

the quality and accessibility of the foundational legal-entity data on which you depend.

Today we offer the world's largest open legal-entity database, providing a single unified set of 
company records from over 140 government registries and other official sources around the world.

Top 5 Reasons your Vias Cause your High Speed Signals to Fail
Your traces look good. Your connections look perfect. But your high speed board still fails channel
analysis. In this video, EE design consultant Kirsch Mackey counts down the top 5 via mistakes that
quietly wreck high speed signals, and shows you exactly how to fix each one. Vias aren't just
vertical connections through the board. At high speeds and short rise times, they're discontinuities
for the electromagnetic wave. Manage them wrong, and your channel signals can fail even when the
layout looks flawless. In this video: 00:00 – Intro: why vias fail even when everything else looks
right 00:25 – Mistake #5: Bad antipad geometry 00:51 – Mistake #4: Using the wrong via type for your
data rate 02:05 – Mistake #3: Ignoring via stub resonance 03:02 – Mistake #2: Asymmetric
differential pair vias 03:54 – Mistake #1: Signal vias without a return via 05:15 – Key takeaway

# Leading Global Pharmaceutical Company

Salvavidas Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is committed to being the world’s leading manufacturer and
exporter of finished dosage forms (FDFs) and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs). Our main goal
is to improve patient outcomes while establishing industry-defining standards. We strive to produce
necessary drugs that are affordable, easily available, and effective.

## We are offering
## best Services & Products

High-quality pharmaceutical, ayurvedic, and antibiotic medications are available from Salvavidas
Pharmaceutical, a well-known pharmaceutical manufacturer and supplier in India. Customers can choose
from a variety of packaging solutions for their items, and flexible payment alternatives. They
guarantee on-time delivery and keep their prices competitive. Salvavidas Pharmaceutical puts the
needs of its patients first by improving safety, efficacy, convenience, and compliance while
offering reasonably priced goods that benefit both patients and society as a whole.
* 
  
  We Committed to Quality Products
* 
  
  WHO-GMP & ISO Certified Facilities

## We Committed for a Better Life

### Salvavidas pharma is a leading pharmaceutical manufacturing and export company in India

We place a high priority on customer happiness, which we accomplish by offering high-quality
medicines on schedule and at fair prices. We promise that every product meets the highest caliber
throughout its development, manufacturing, sale, distribution, etc. We are dedicated to establishing
and preserving solid bonds with our clients worldwide. As a result, we are now recognized as a
reliable exporter offering service globally.

## What we bring to you

Salvavidas Pharma is a well-known Indian pharmaceutical exporter that provides a wide variety of
medications to international markets. The organization, which is based in Surat, Gujarat, is one of
the greatest places to find pharmaceutical items. It provides a wide range of products that are
developed to fulfill the requirements of its customers, such as antimalarials, analgesics, and
antibiotics. Salvavidas Pharma, which has a large worldwide presence, focuses on public health as a
driver for social and economic advancement. It is currently one of the leading pharmaceutical firms
in India.

Salvavidas Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. exports to more than 40 nations across five continents: Africa,
South-East Asia, Latin America, North America, and the CIS region. We are an Indian manufacturer and
exporter of all pharmaceutical items with more than 500 product registrations worldwide.

[Why Does Professional Power Amplifier Have Bridge Connection? What Does The Bridging Function
Do?][94]

Bridge mode is a connection method for power amplifiers in the professional audio field.Most
professional audio amplifiers support bridging. Set the status of the amplifier to bridge mode
(BTL), and then the speaker wiring is connected across the output stage (positive) of the two
channels, and the speaker is not grounded. As for the phase positive and negative, the power
amplifier will have the positive and negative poles of the BTL.

Bridge mode is a connection method for power amplifiers in the professional audio field.Most
professional audio amplifiers support bridging. Set the status of the amplifier to bridge mode
(BTL), and then the speaker wiring is connected across the output stage (positive) of the two
channels, and the speaker is not grounded. As for the phase positive and negative, the power

# Smart RF Smarter World

At Smartcom-DS, we specialize in cutting-edge Radio Frequency (RF) and Microwave solutions for
modern communication, defense, aerospace, and Telecom applications.

## End to End RF Solutions

Our expertise covers the end-to-end spectrum of RF engineering—from concept design and simulation to
prototyping, testing, and large-scale production. We take pride in offering customized solutions
that integrate seamlessly into our clients’ systems, ensuring reliability, efficiency, and
innovation.

## [Custom Antenna Design ][30]

Tailored solutions to match your specific requirements, ensuring optimal performance in your
application.

## [Quality Assurance][31]

Rigorous testing and quality control processes to guarantee reliability and performance.

## [Expert Consultation][32]

Experienced engineers provides support from concept to deployment, ensuring your project’s success.
[Three industrial whip antennas: black flexible, white pole-mounted with bracket, and grey
pedestal-mounted.]
About smartcom

## Unmatched Performance – Exceptional Quality

Smartcom Design & Solution is a leading Indian antenna manufacturer and RF solutions provider for
telecom, defence and space applications. Our team specialises in the design, development, and
manufacturing of both standard and customised antennas, RF products, and complete RF and microwave
solutions.
We are proud to be part of the Make in India initiative, sourcing most input materials locally while
maintaining global-class quality standards. Combining advanced materials, proprietary design
principles and deep RF system expertise, we deliver antenna systems and RF assemblies engineered for
demanding environments and next-generation wireless standards.

We work closely with OEMs, system integrators and network operators to deliver application-specific
